name: supervisor-request-shape
description: create_worker carries routing, placement and capacity only. placement_key is required: without it a supervisor could hand this connection to a worker holding another user's connections (session model §4; Contract §4: users are tenants). It has a user name's shape, so a per_user key is the owning TSB login name as is, '@' included. A credential or any connect detail in create_worker is refused by the schema: credentials reach a worker only through connect.auth on the connection's own socket, never through the process that spawns workers, their argv or their environment. Every request in a collected supervisor capture must be this shape.

instances.note: a TSB login name may hold '@'; a per_user key is that name as is
no placement_key: the supervisor could not keep one user's connections apart from another's
a worker holds at least one
